incident-bot: RCA published — Runtime retry storm (link): https://redwood.internal/rcas/1771504321-runtime-retry-storm.pdf :page_facing_up:

incident-bot: TL;DR — a source of intermittent KV request failures caused client libs to aggressively retry, which amplified load, triggered autoscaler churn, and led to request queues filling on a small subset of serving nodes. Root cause: degraded KV cluster partitions + lack of retry backoff/circuit breakers.

(taylor): Thanks everyone. Key highlights from the RCA and immediate next steps: 1) Change default retry backoff from fixed to exponential w/ jitter (owner: raj, due: 2026-03-30). 2) Add per-host circuit-breaker in the runtime for KV request failures (owner: jen, due: 2026-04-06). 3) Autoscaler smoothing + chaos tests for scaling hysteresis (owner: mike, due: 2026-04-13).

(raj): I already pushed a small config change to the dev branch to enable exponential backoff for new deployments. Will open a PR for prod rollout tomorrow. :hammer_and_wrench:

(jen): I'll draft the circuit-breaker design doc today and include perf/latency rollback criteria. Ping me if you have specific failure modes to include.

(mike): Adding e2e test scenario to simulate KV tail latency spikes. Will schedule a canary run on Dedicated next Wed.

(emily): I've scheduled the postmortem follow-up checkpoint: 2026-04-07 16:00 UTC (30m). Agenda: review action-item progress, confirm tests, and schedule any additional mitigations. Invite sent to eng-sre, eng-runtime, and product.

(ops-oncall): FYI — KV vendor also acknowledged a transient region issue during the incident window; they're supplying node logs. Putting those in the RCA appendix.

(taylor): Two quick asks: 1) owners please add status updates to the RCA doc by EOD Monday. 2) if you need temporary capacity or a rollback window for rollout, comment in the RCA so infra can approve. :eyes:

(raj): Ack. I'll add PR links and a rollout plan.

(jen): Ack, will add design + test plan.

(mike): Ack — test harness + canary details will be in the RCA follow-up section.

(emily): If anyone can't make the 4/7 checkpoint, please post a short update in this thread beforehand.

(taylor): Big thanks to the oncall and SRE teams for fast mitigation and to everyone who contributed artifacts. We'll treat this as a playbook update item once follow-ups are complete. :clap:
